rationale: The plan matches the reference exactly on the core design: subject as a fixed block in both full (~ subject + condition) and reduced (~ subject) models, an omnibus DESeq2 LRT for 'any treatment effect', then three explicitly named factor/numerator/denominator Wald contrasts with ashr shrinkage and BH at 0.05 within contrast, plus an edgeR QL joint F-test on the identical design as a robustness check rather than separate subset fits. QC is blind-VST PCA coloured by both subject and condition with distance heatmap and library sizes, and the outlier policy is to flag rather than drop; the filter (>=10 counts in >=4 samples, the smallest group) is minimal and justified, and normalization is median-of-ratios/TMM inside the model on raw counts. Enrichment was not explicitly requested, but it is specified correctly (fgsea on full Wald-statistic ranking, tested genes as universe, human hallmark then human-filtered Reactome with versions, 15-500 size window, seed recorded), so it costs little. The report section names method, versions, design, reference level, thresholds, n tested/n significant, Cook's NA accounting, residual df, missing length offset and whole-blood composition caveats. Minor deductions only for the somewhat vague QC outlier policy ('report concerns for the modelling step to weigh').
